question.text: 'Long-only' strategies for Cat III AIFs primarily target:

answer.text: Fundamental stock selection and appreciation from long positions

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 238-240 of the workbook, long-only strategies take buy positions and seek returns from those long positions using top-down or bottom-up fundamental stock selection. The Trap: Shorting, arbitrage and currency trading describe different strategy types, not the long-only approach. Note: Long-only Cat III AIFs resemble equity mutual funds in approach but differ in fee structure, leverage rules and investor base.
